d:
Makhane se bane svadisht aur paushtik modak (Makhana Modak), kailshiyam aur protin se bhare, banane men aasan, tyoharon par mithaee ke rup men bahut achchha lagta hai aur ye phalahari bhi hai, yani ise vrat men bhi kha sakte hain. tyohar, ganapti utsav aur khas maukon ke lie ek behatrin mithaee hain. agar aap traditional modak se kuchh alag banana chahte hain, to is Festival Special Modak Recipe resipi jarur banaie
